blocks.text: Yet we think we have sufficiently proved in the Notes to this chapter that all these things also fit the grey heron; hence I am in doubt between the stork and the grey heron. Oedmann, however, is certain that the Hebrews' חסידה is the grey heron, and Michaelis too inclines to this opinion, in Supplemm. ad Lexx. Hebrr. vol.
